Name: Elishama, Son of Jekamiah
Summary: Son of Jekamiah, named at the end of the Jerahmeel line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:41: Son of Jekamiah, named at the end of the Jerahmeel line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elishama stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
